answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 3 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The umber debit happens at intake, spiral totals the burned amount, and forge anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm as a result forfeits the burn once for every sock puppet on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. That is 5 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
